message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
Calories can vary slightly depending on the tomato’s size and variety:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | ~15 kcal |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | ~22 kcal |
| Large (≈182 g)        | ~33 kcal |

These values are averages; actual numbers may differ based on ripeness, cultivar, and growing conditions.
